title: Store settings
name: Store name
logoHelp: Upload a JPEG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF image up to 5 MB. The header uses it after you save.
faviconHelp: The browser tab uses this image after you save. Remove it to keep the default icon.
uploadFailed: The image could not be uploaded.
colorHelp: Leave a color blank to use the HoneyChic default. The primary color needs strong contrast with white text.
socialHelp: Use https links. Blank fields stay hidden on the storefront.
accountsHelp: Turning accounts off blocks customer sign-in. Owner and staff can still sign in.
unpaidOrderHoursHelp: Leave blank to keep unpaid orders open. Pending unpaid orders older than this are cancelled and their stock returns, including cash-on-delivery orders still pending.
accountsMoved: Customer accounts, registration and guest checkout are switched on the page
